## [1.3.4](https://github.com/Kero309x/anghamiplus-patches/compare/v1.3.3...v1.3.4) (2026-10-06)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* match the fingerprints against the verified 8.0.28 signatures ([f90c5c0](https://github.com/Kero309x/anghamiplus-patches/commit/f90c5c04b293a49c6f779a49d7ca129891f3991f))

patches.name: Allow Screenshots
patches.description: Bypasses secure window restrictions to allow screenshots and screen recording across the app.

patches.name: Block Audio Ads
patches.description: Prevents audio advertisements between songs and treats playback tracks as ad-free.

patches.name: Block Promotional Popups
patches.description: Blocks startup popup offers, promotional flyers, and marketing dialogs.

patches.name: Disable Analytics & Crash Logging
patches.description: Disables third-party trackers (Braze, Adjust, Firebase, Google, Bugsnag), in-house Silo tracking, and listening telemetry.

patches.name: Disable Forced Shuffle
patches.description: Disables forced shuffle mode on playlists and radio, enabling full on-demand song selection.

patches.name: Disable In-App Rating
patches.description: Disables the in-app review dialogs and 'Love us? Rate us!' rating prompts.

patches.name: Expand Download Limits
patches.description: Removes local offline storage caps and disables limited-plan quota checks.

patches.name: Hide Gold Upsell
patches.description: Hides Gold-tier promotional sections and unsupported server-gated features.

patches.name: Hide Premium Feature Buttons
patches.description: Hides locked upsell buttons including Sing Along (Karaoke) and AI Mix triggers.

patches.name: Hide Shuffle Badges
patches.description: Hides 'Plays in shuffle' badges from playlists, album headers, and feed rows.

patches.name: Hide Upgrade Banners
patches.description: Hides navigation upgrade tab, header promo banners, and feed subscription upsell cards.

patches.name: Remove Sponsored Content
patches.description: Hides sponsored cards, recommended promotions in Car Mode, and radar sponsored content.

patches.name: Show Profile Plus Badge
patches.description: Displays the official Plus badge on your profile header and account settings.

patches.name: Spoof App Signature
patches.description: Emulates official application signature headers to preserve API authorization compatibility.

patches.name: Unlimited Track Skips
patches.description: Removes song skip limitations and queue navigation restrictions.

patches.name: Unlock Full Lyrics
patches.description: Enables full synced lyrics display and removes paywall banners on song lyrics.

patches.name: Unlock Plus Experience
patches.description: Enables client-side Plus features, eliminates free-tier playback restrictions, and enables offline UI mode.
